needed.evidence: The left side lacks a purpose-built sidewalk, consisting of a concrete area used for parking and storage.
needed.suggestion: Construct a proper, continuous sidewalk on the left side of the road to separate pedestrians from vehicle traffic.

needed.evidence: The walking area on the left is blocked by parked cars and construction materials.
needed.suggestion: Remove the parked vehicles and construction debris from the left-hand pedestrian area to ensure clear passage.

needed.evidence: There are uneven surfaces and piles of sand/dirt on the left walking area.
needed.suggestion: Level the surface and clear debris from the left-hand walking area to remove trip hazards.

needed.evidence: There is high crossing demand due to shops on the right and a bus stop, but no designated crossing facility is provided.
needed.suggestion: Install a marked or signalised pedestrian crossing to provide a safe way for people to cross the road.
